Name: Maggs Townsfolk Daily Dialogue Expansion
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]IMPORTANT!! Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.
Updating: delete the old Magg’s Daily Townsfolk Dialogue folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

Compatible with all of Maggs mods, and most other mods.

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Daily dialogue expansion for Pelican Town residents:
This mod can be used on its own, and it also compliments Maggs Immersive Sebastian, Sam, and Alex mods. I will continue adding dialogue to this mod as I create more immersive content.

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Characters[/b][/size][/color]
All dialogue is up to 8 hearts, no romance or marriage dialogue is included in this mod.
[*][b]Abigail[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue, some dated dialogue for the first year
[*][b]Alex[/b] - daily, seasonal, animation, rain, and festival dialogue, dated dialogue for the first year
[*][b]Demetrius[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*]﻿[b]Evelyn[/b] - festival dialogue
[*]﻿[b]George[/b] - festival dialogue
[*][b]Haley[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*][b]Jodi[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*][b]Kent[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*][b]Maru[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*]﻿[b]Penny[/b] - daily, seasonal, and festival dialogue
[*][b]Robin[/b] - daily and seasonal dialogue
[*][b]Sam[/b] - daily, seasonal, animation, rain, and festival dialogue, some dated dialogue for the first year
[*][b]Sebastian[/b] - daily, seasonal, animation, rain, and festival dialogue, dated dialogue for the first year
[*][b]Vincent[/b] - daily dialogue
[*][b]All other characters[/b] - a few reactions, dialogue to be added over time

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
Uncheck any character to remove their dialogue.
If you have one of the Magg's Immersive mods installed, the dialogue is automatically disabled in this mod for the main character.

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Planned Updates[/b][/size][/color]
See the dev sticky post for current updates.

[b][size=4][color=red]Permissions[/color][/size][/b]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. I work many hours on my mods and I would hate to see them uploaded by someone who didn’t do the work.
[b]Translation: [/b]Please message me to let me know you want to translate. I will tell you if anyone else has already started a translation in your language and answer any questions you might have.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Special Thanks[/size][/color][/b]
Thanks to my wonderful beta tester, proofreader, and comment moderator AziMinohi1992
